To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have implemented a hardware and software Co Design system for real time processing and bidirectional transfer of data on the ZedBoard SoC platform, for a Time to Digital converter implemented in the Programmables Logic of a Zynq 7000 FPGA.

a hardware and software system on chip platform is able to perform timing measurements with high accuracy, low latency, high throughput and low power consumption, with a high degree of flexibility in the number of channels, in the resolution and in the full scale range, and with a high degree, of reconfigurability of the system, all these features being achieved with a low area occupation on chip.

we implemented a hardware and software system that performs real time bidirectional transfer and processing of data from a multi-channel Time to Digital Converter, with a high performance architecture, implemented in the PL section of a Zynq 7000 All Programmable SoC.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the implementation of a system for real time acquisition and processing of data from a Time to digital converter, the TDC, implemented in the PL section of a SoC platform, the Zynq XC7Z020, hosted on board the ZedBoard, for timing measurements.
the design of a system for the implementation of the IP core on a SoC platform for real time measurements of the time interval between two events.
the development of an FPGA based, multi channel, high resolution Time to Digital Converter with tunable resolution, tunable full scale range and tunable number of channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system presented is a very flexible, efficient and cost effective solution for the implementation of high performance, high resolution, multi-channel TDCs in the ZedBoard platform.
the proposed architecture is able to provide an average resolution of 0.5 ps, a maximum resolution of 0,2 ps, a full scale range of 10,7 ns and a number of channels programmable from 1 to 8.

the proposed system on chip architecture, based on a Zynq 7000 series All Programable SoC, has been successfully implemented and it can be used for the acquisition of time domain signals and the measurement of the time of flight between two points in space with an accuracy in the range of few ps and a time resolution of 20ps, with a maximum sampling rate of 100MS/s per channel, a maximum number of channels up to 8 and a maximum time resolution of 2
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed and integrated a Time to Digital Converters with a real time processing system on the Zynq platform.

, in order to achieve the best performance, we have developed a complete and flexible system, able to transfer data from the Tapped Delay Line TDC to the Processing System (PS) of the ZynQ 7XC7Z020 and vice versa in real time, by means of a DMA controller, and to process them in order to extract the timing measurements.
we implemented a complete hardware and software system on chip for real time data acquisition, bidirectional data transfer, processing and visualization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hardware and software co designed system allows the real time transfer and processing of the data generated by the Time to Digital Converter in the PL section of the ZedBoard.
the ZedBoard platform can be used for the implementation of a complete SoC for time to digital conversion and data processing in real time.

a hardware and software based co design system is a very effective way to implement a system on a chip platform, in which the hardware part is responsible for data acquisition and processing, while the software part is used to control the hardware, to configure it and to display and store the results.
